bifrost: springboard/src/shell/settings.rs, springboard/src/shell/pages.rs (shell-owned Settings app; no third-party pane host)
summary: Apple's framework lets third-party bundles plug panes into System Settings, with a lifecycle (select, unselect veto) and Help menu keys. BifrOSt has a shell-owned Settings app with its own page model and a fixed shell Help menu, but no bundle or plugin host for external panes, no pane lifecycle notifications, and apps cannot add Help menu items.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 3 (theme-08, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No API lets an app or bundle supply a pane; Settings builds every page from its own PageId enum (springboard/src/shell/pages.rs).

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Wave 3 (theme-08, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Pages are built in code from specs; no nib or view load hook for external panes.

features.feature: Keyboard focus chain in a pane
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. Focus traversal exists as a pure model (next/nearest over Focusable items), but there is no per-pane initial or last key view and no autosave of text fields on pane change.

features.feature: Help menu entries from a pane
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/help_menu.rs (PaneHelpMenu, HelpEntry); springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs:193 (Help menu rows, fixed)
features.note: PaneHelpMenu holds the entries of each selected pane (title and anchor), replaces them on update and removes them on unselect, tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-gaps-04.rs. Gap: the shell does not draw pane entries yet (its Help menu rows are fixed at desktop_bar.rs:193), no pane selection calls the model, and there is no help-book lookup for the anchor.

features.apple: System Settings panes as shipped by the OS (no app API)
features.note: The Settings app covers the OS preferences (network, display, notifications, focus, general) as its counterpart, but it is closed to third-party panes.

features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. features.apple: x-apple.systempreferences: URL with a pane identifier and an optional ?anchor (System Settings deep links)
features.note: Pure builder, reader and router with headless tests in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-46.rs: plain-token identifiers and anchors, split at the first '?', and a link sorted into an open pane, an unlisted pane or a non-link. Not wired: the shell does not call the router yet, Settings pages have no identifier table (macOS 27 identifiers are not verified in docs/parity-matrix/os/settings; com.apple.preference.displays appears only as a LaunchAgent name in the daemons inventory), and no link opens the Settings app. Not tested on the VM or Midget.

gaps: No plugin host that loads a third-party pane into the Settings app (NSPreferencePane equivalent), so apps cannot add a settings pane.
No pane lifecycle (select, deselect with veto) or pane notifications for a Settings page.
Apps cannot add items to the shell Help menu or use a help anchor; the Help menu rows are fixed in desktop_bar.rs.
No per-pane initial and last key view, and no text field autosave on pane change.
No pane bundle format or plist-declared pane and help keys.
